answer: The shale register is checked at draw time, island lists the eligible set, and dawn seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 43 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 43 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. A 465 account operation therefore ties up 22 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
